summary: An interior compliance transition (e.g. drift.detected) refused at capacity while bracketing events for the same rule are admitted self-clears via the seq-guard with no repair ever synthesized; the server's audit history shows continuous compliance through a real violation window even though current state is accurate. events_lost still increments (aggregate signal survives) but per-rule attribution and the compensating census correction are lost.

summary: legacy_sink_kick() (heartbeat thread, off mtx_) and stop()'s final persist (shutdown thread, under mtx_) both ran an unsynchronized snapshot->decide->write->record-gen sequence coordinated only by a standalone atomic; a late in-flight kick() could resume after a concurrent stop() had already persisted fresher data and overwrite it with its own stale snapshot, silently regressing the restart-durable ledger UP-3's fix exists to protect. A pure CAS on the atomic alone would not have closed this (the physical KV write order between the two threads was the actual hazard, not just the tracked generation value). TSan cannot detect this class (no unsynchronized memory access, a logical check-then-act ordering bug).

summary: A fresh DGRHP (real Windows, MSVC) re-verification pass - requested after the user asked 'is this a solid PR?' and 'have we run all necessary governance?' - reproduced a SIGSEGV (0xC0000005) 3/3 across independent process runs in the UP-2 cap test. summary: External adversarial review of PR #4923 (fjarvis, running the standing Codex+Kimi-K3 panel, independently converged and cross-examined) found a genuine correctness gap SEQ-GUARDED CLEARING did not close: offer()'s is_gap_repair admission branch stamped GapRecord::repair_seq on whatever gap was currently live for a rule_id, with no check that it was the SAME loss episode GuardianEngine::legacy_sink_kick() captured via gapped_rules_needing_repair(). Reachable interleaving: kick selects gap for loss L1, a real Sent clears it before the repair reaches offer(), a fresh loss L2 reopens the SAME rule's gap, then the paused kick's stale L1 repair finally offers - it binds to L2's live gap and, on its own later Sent, SEQ-GUARDED CLEARING's `it.seq > lost_seq` check passes trivially (the repair's admission seq necessarily postdates L2's lost_seq, since offer() always runs after the episode it races against) and silently erases L2 - a newer loss the repair never actually observed. Independently verified by reading the code directly (offer()'s admission stamp, account_outcome_locked's Sent-clearing check, record_gap_locked's fresh-GapRecord construction) before accepting the reviewer's claim. Fixed: offer() now takes an optional expected_gap_lost_seq (threaded from GuardianEngine::legacy_sink_kick()'s own gapped_rules_needing_repair() capture, through emit_guard_event()); the admission stamp only fires on an exact match against the CURRENT gap's lost_seq, and a mismatch leaves repair_seq untouched so the PRE-EXISTING DEQUEUE-TIME SUPERSESSION machinery suppresses the stale item before its send() ever runs, with zero new suppression counters needed. Falsifiability proven directly: reverted the fix to the pre-fix unconditional stamp, reran the new regression test, confirmed it fails exactly as predicted (the L2 gap is erased - `after_stale.size() == 0`), then restored the fix and confirmed clean. New deterministic regression test added (test_guardian_legacy_sink_executor.cpp, 'ADMISSION-TIME EPISODE BINDING') reproducing the exact reported interleaving directly against the executor (gapped_rules_needing_repair() capture, then a real Sent clear+reopen, then the stale repair offer()'d with the captured lost_seq) plus a companion check that a correctly-scoped live repair still clears normally. Full legacy_sink ([legacy_sink]) and guardian ([guardian]) suites green under both a plain build and TSan (BigColin's pre-built x64-linux-tsan tree) after the fix, zero new TSan warnings.
trigger: a rule's gap clears via a real delivery, then reopens via a fresh loss for the SAME rule, before a paused legacy_sink_kick() call's already-selected repair for the OLD episode reaches offer()
classification_rationale: A genuine reachable race that silently discards real loss-accounting evidence, contradicting SEQ-GUARDED CLEARING's own stated purpose - not a wording or doc issue.
